title: a running theme in my mallworld dreams
content: in most of my mallworld dreams, i just sort of randomly spawn there. but sometimes there's a backstory and it's always the same. i start out in an airport lounge where i find out that my flight's either been cancelled or i missed it. i start to stress out but then something physically picks me up and throws me down some kind of slide/chute and i end up in the middle of the mallworld. it's scary at first but once i realize where i am im pretty comforted since it's a familiar place. do you guys always randomly spawn in to the mallworld or do you get backstories?
